Now come on Kevin. No one who says a foetus is human is meaning it in the same way as a toe is human. A foetus is human because it is a human being. It is a unique, totally new human person with its own unique DNA.

You don’t have civil rights because you’re a human. You have rights because you’re a person. If your brain dies, you can still be alive, and you’re still a human, but you no longer have the qualities of being a person. For that reason, we allow brain dead people to be disconnected from life support without calling it murder. A fetus is not yet a person.
